title: Fake Embassy Email
scenario: An email claims your embassy needs a travel-registration payment.

answers.A: Find the embassy website through your government site.
answers.B: Pay the registration fee through the email link.
answers.C: Call the embassy using a number you locate independently.
answers.D: Reply with your travel dates so the embassy can match your record.

explanation: Embassies can provide travel advice, but an unexpected payment request needs independent confirmation. Do not use the email contact path.
proTip: Government identity should be verified through a government domain.
